AA.I.A.K1.text: Landing gear–extension/retraction system(s), indicators, float devices, brakes, antiskid, tires, nose- wheel steering, and shock absorbers.

AA.I.A.K12.text: Flight controls–ailerons, elevator(s), rudder(s), control tabs, control boost/augmentation systems, flaps, spoilers, leading edge devices, speed brakes, stability augmentation system (e.g., yaw damper), and trim systems.

AA.I.A.K15.text: Envelope protection–angle of attack warning and protection, and speed protection.

AA.I.A.K6.text: Hydraulic system–capacity, pumps, pressure, reservoirs, allowable types of fluid, and regulators.

AA.I.A.K8.text: Pneumatic and environmental systems–heating, cooling, ventilation, oxygen, pressurization, supply for ice protection systems, controls, indicators, and regulating devices.

AA.I.A.K9.text: Avionics and communications–autopilot, flight director, Electronic Flight Instrument Systems (EFIS), Flight Management System (FMS), Electronic Flight Bag (EFB), Radar, Inertial Navigation Systems (INS), Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), Space-Based Augmentation System (SBAS), Ground-Based

AA.I.B.K2b.text: b. Takeoff performance [e.g., balance field length and Velocity, Minimum Control (ground) (VMCG)] 4

AA.I.C.K2a.text: a. Airport Observations (METAR and SPECI) and Pilot Observations (PIREP)

AA.I.C.K2b.text: b. Surface Analysis Chart, Ceiling and Visibility Chart (CVA)

AA.I.C.K2e.text: e. Wind and Temperature Aloft Forecast (FB)
